document.title: Visible Text defaults, exported prop types, centred Button labels
document.summary: Three author-experience fixes: the SDK exports the alignment and phase types its props use, `Text` defaults to the theme text colour at 20px and x/y 0, and `Button` gains `align` with vertically centred, horizontally centred-by-default labels.
document.why: Authors building the demo Deck App hit invisible black `Text` on the default theme, could not name `TextAlign`/`StackAlign`/`PadButtonPhase`, and could not centre a Button label ([#102](source:s1), [#103](source:s2), [#105](source:s3)).

sources.title: Text defaults are invisible on the default theme
sources.gist: Default Text colour to the theme, x/y to 0, align fontSize with Button, document it.

sources.title: Export TextAlign, StackAlign and PadButtonPhase from the SDK
sources.gist: Additive type exports from the SDK index.

sources.title: Button has no label alignment prop
sources.gist: Add align (default center) and vertical centring; refresh the smoke golden.

sources.label: PR #113
sources.title: fix(sdk): visible Text defaults, exported prop types, centred Button labels

lookFor: [#102](source:s1) asks for `theme.foreground`; the `Theme` type has no such field, so `Text` defaults to `theme.text`.
[#102](source:s1) asks to note the default change in release notes; the repo has no changelog, so the PR body carries it.

parts.name: Exported types
parts.summary: The SDK index re-exports the prop and pad-button types authors need to name.

parts.name: Text defaults
parts.summary: `Text` defaults to the theme text colour, fontSize 20 and x/y 0, and examples that relied on the old offset pass it explicitly.

parts.name: Button align
parts.summary: `Button` takes `align`, carried through the runtime and native props to a centred label draw, with a refreshed smoke golden.

groups.title: Export prop types
groups.why: Authors cannot name these types without `Parameters<>` gymnastics ([#103](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The SDK index re-exports `PadButtonPhase` from `pad-buttons` and `StackAlign`, `StackDirection`, `TextAlign`, `TextWrap` from the host prop types.

groups.title: Text defaults
groups.why: Black text is invisible on the default OLED theme and the 8px offset and 30px size are out of line with the other elements ([#102](source:s1)).
groups.summary: The SDK `Text` component fills `color` from `useTheme()`, while the reconciler and the native fallback in `fonts.h` move the size to 20 and the position to 0.
lookFor: The colour default lives in the SDK component; a raw `vita-text` host element without `color` still draws black from the native fallback in `render.c`.
`fontSize={0}` now falls back to 20 natively instead of 30, matching the JS default.

groups.title: Examples keep their Text offset
groups.why: The examples and scaffold relied on the old 8px offset; passing it explicitly keeps their look while the default moves.
groups.summary: Each `Text` without `x`/`y` in minesweeper, timers (including the tick-log placeholder inside the `Scroll` from #98) and the scaffold template gains `x={8} y={8}`; smoke already passes every prop, so its golden does not move for this part.

groups.title: Button align end to end
groups.why: A centred label is the common case for a button and there was no way to get one ([#105](source:s3)).
groups.summary: `VitaButtonProps.align` flows through the reconciler as argument 22 of `nativeCreateButton`/`nativeUpdateButton` into `ButtonProps.align`, and `render_button_instance` measures the label with the rounding `measure_text_width`, places it with `text_layout_line_x` and centres it on `text_line_height`.
lookFor: Breaking (visual): every existing Button label moves from top-left padding 8 to centred, because the reconciler passes `"center"` when `align` is unset.
Subtle: a label wider than the button minus 16px padding now overflows on both sides when centred, where it used to overflow only on the right.

`BUTTON_ARGC` goes from 22 to 23, so an older runtime bundle calling with 22 arguments makes the native create/update a no-op; the runtime and host ship together, so this only bites a stale `js/dist`.

groups.title: Demo lists stay left-aligned; golden refresh
groups.why: The demo's section nav and Scroll row read as list items, and the smoke golden must match the new centred labels.
groups.summary: The demo nav and Scroll-section Buttons pass `align="left"`, and the Linux golden differs from the old one only inside the two smoke Button labels.
